notes:
Patch release for **1.14.0** — if you already installed 1.14.0, this update fixes the `chatoss` command.

## Fixed: `chatoss` was not executable in the macOS build

The 1.14.0 macOS build shipped the bundled `chatoss` CLI binary without its executable permission, so `chatoss launch …` failed with “permission denied” and **Settings → Launch → “Install chatoss command”** linked a file that couldn’t run. 1.14.1 ships it executable — install (or update), then:

```bash
chatoss launch claude-code    # needs the claude CLI — npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
chatoss launch opencode       # needs opencode — install from opencode.ai
chatoss launch codex          # needs the codex CLI — npm install -g @openai/codex
```

Everything else from 1.14.0 is unchanged:

- **`chatoss launch`** — run Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex on your ChatOSS models (local Ollama, ChatOSS cloud, or your own API-key provider) through ChatOSS’s local model server (127.0.0.1 only). Settings → Launch has the explainer, server status, and the CLI installer.
- **Ask mode can investigate freely** (read-only tools, no Auto-mode prompt).
- **Token estimator honors MCP toggles** instantly.
- **Orchestrators no longer stall on sub-agents**; failed reports arrive immediately.
- **Messages sent mid-turn are never lost.**
- **Kanban, Connect, and Models run on the shared chat engine.**
